objects.name: VCS_PREVIOUS_CYCLE_ENTRY_V
objects.query:
SELECT
PreviousCycleDetailsEO.bucket_id AS PREVIOUS_BUCKET_ID,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID ,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.IS_CURRENT_FLAG AS ENTRY_CURRENT_FLAG,
PreviousCycleDetailsEO.entry_detail_id previous_entry_detail_id,
PreviousCycleDetailsEO.QUANTITY AS PREVIOUS_QUANTITY,
PreviousCycleDetailsEO.RESPONSE_QUANTITY AS PREVIOUS_RESPONSE_QUANTITY,
PreviousCycleDetailsEO.RESPONSE_QUANTITY_UOM AS PREVIOUS_RESPONSE_QUANTITY_UOM,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.entry_id as CurrentEntryID,
PreviousCycleEntriesEO.entry_id as PreviousEntryID,
PreviousCycleEntriesEO.primary_uom_code AS PREVIOUS_PRIMARY_UOM_CODE,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.SHIP_TO_ID,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ORG_ID,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.PUBLISHED_DATE,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.COMMIT_DATE,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.LAST_UPDATE_DATE as ENTRY_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.LAST_UPDATED_BY,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN AS ENTRY_LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER AS OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER_ENT,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.SHIP_FROM_ID,
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.ORCH_CORRELATION_CODE
FROM
VCS_COLLAB_ENT CurrentCycleEntriesEO
LEFT JOIN VCS_COLLAB_ENT PreviousCycleEntriesEO ON CurrentCycleEntriesEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID = PreviousCycleEntriesEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID AND
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ORG_ID = PreviousCycleEntriesEO.INVENTORY_ITEM_ORG_ID AND
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.SHIP_TO_ID = PreviousCycleEntriesEO.SHIP_TO_ID AND
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.SHIP_FROM_ID = PreviousCycleEntriesEO.SHIP_FROM_ID AND
CurrentCycleEntriesEO.COLLAB_SOURCE_ID = PreviousCycleEntriesEO.COLLAB_SOURCE_ID AND
PreviousCycleEntriesEO.IS_CURRENT_FLAG = 'N'
LEFT JOIN VCS_PLANNING_SCH_DETAILS PreviousCycleDetailsEO ON PreviousCycleDetailsEO.COLLAB_ENTRY_ID =PreviousCycleEntriesEO.entry_id AND
PreviousCycleDetailsEO.IS_CURRENT_FLAG = 'Y'
WHERE CurrentCycleEntriesEO.IS_CURRENT_FLAG = 'Y'
